key_risks_to_thesis: A sharp steepening or inversion of the yield curve could compress JPM's net interest margin materially, directly pressuring the revenue and EPS growth trend that underpins the bull case.

JPM's P/E premium over peers (13x vs. C at 10x) could compress if credit loss provisions surge — particularly in its large consumer and commercial loan books — eroding the EPS CAGR that justifies the valuation gap.

Regulatory capital requirement increases (e.g., Basel III endgame finalization demanding higher CET1 ratios) could force JPM to curtail buybacks and dividend growth, reducing the earnings-per-share compounding mechanism central to the thesis.
